learn: Telegram could not open the demo player because replies used a relative /vita/kids-player path inside unclickable <code> and keyboards were callbacks only. Fix: absolute HTTPS vitaPlayerHref(..., popup=1), Watch popup Mini App (web_app) plus ↗ Open player url fallback, stripWebAppButtons retry when BotFather domain is missing, compact player (Telegram.WebApp.ready without expand) + Pop out window.open, playlist picker loads system catalogs (demo WAV, KIDS url dir, feed-library). /vitafeed play and /vitafeed play demo open the demo WAV; /vitafeed play kids opens the closed garden. Never invent tx hashes.
